_comment: Faction identity in the HUD. Two Spartan spear blocks face two Roman ones, each pair already standing in a different stance, with all-teams control so the clip can select a regiment from EACH side. The clip is deliberately still -- nobody moves, nobody fights, and no formation is re-formed mid-clip -- because the whole change is display text: what moves is the control-bar formation button, the info panel's Formation line, and its new Faction / Doctrine lines. Selecting the four blocks in turn reads pyknosis, phalanx, acies, agmen quadratum: the same two stances named twice over, once in each side's own language. Formation ints are the FORMATION_* consts on scripts/Unit.gd (NORMAL 0, SQUARE 3, SHIELD_WALL 4).
